articles.title: BJP MLA’s ₹4,000 Demand from Poor Rickshaw Driver — Crowd Steps In, Police Arrive!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pilibhit, Uttar Pradesh: A controversy erupted in the Khutar police station area after BJP MLA from Puranpur, Baburam Paswan, allegedly demanded ₹4,000 from an e-rickshaw driver following a minor collision.

body.html:
Pilibhit, Uttar Pradesh: A controversy erupted in the Khutar police station area after BJP MLA from Puranpur, Baburam Paswan, allegedly demanded ₹4,000 from an e-rickshaw driver following a minor collision.

The incident occurred near Tikunia intersection on the Assam Highway when Paswan’s Scorpio reportedly brushed against an e-rickshaw driven by Chhatrapal, a resident of Lakhimpur Kheri. The MLA allegedly accused the driver of breaking his car’s indicator and demanded compensation.

When the driver pleaded that he was poor and could not afford to pay, the MLA reportedly continued to insist. A crowd soon gathered and protested against the MLA’s behaviour, collecting ₹4,000 through public donations to support the driver. Police later reached the spot and dispersed the crowd.

Videos of the altercation quickly went viral on social media, drawing sharp criticism of the MLA’s conduct. Responding to media questions, Paswan reportedly said, “What business is it of yours?”

However, the Khutar police denied the extortion allegation, stating that the e-rickshaw had hit the MLA’s car from behind and that no money was demanded.

articles.title: Delhi’s Midnight Chaos: Woman Dragged by SUV Outside Luxury Hotel — Viral Video Sparks Outrage!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video filmed outside a luxury hotel on Ashoka Road, Delhi, has gone viral, showing two men and a woman assaulting another woman dressed in red near roadside bushes.

body.html:
A video filmed outside a luxury hotel on Ashoka Road, Delhi, has gone viral, showing two men and a woman assaulting another woman dressed in red near roadside bushes.

The footage, reportedly captured late at night, shows the trio physically restraining the woman as she struggles and shouts, “Leave my sister alone.” The scuffle continues as a black SUV — visible in the video — moves a few metres while dragging the woman by her hand. Police lights can be seen towards the end, indicating officers reached the spot soon after.

According to reports party was underway at the hotel around 1 am, with large crowds gathered near the parking area along Janpath.

The black SUV’s presence has also reignited debate following Haryana DGP O.P. Singh’s recent remark linking such vehicles — especially Thars and Bullets — with individuals having a “notorious mindset.”

Police are yet to release an official statement on the incident.

articles.title: Bhopal Model Khushboo Ahirwar’s Mysterious Death — Family Alleges Religious Pressure and Brutal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh — The death of Khushboo Ahirwar, a young model from Sagar district, has sparked massive outrage on social media.

body.html:
Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh — The death of Khushboo Ahirwar, a young model from Sagar district, has sparked massive outrage on social media. Khushboo, who was working in Bhopal, was found dead under suspicious circumstances after allegedly traveling to Ujjain with a man named Qasim Ahmed, who initially introduced himself as Rahul.

According to the family, Khushboo was brought back to Bhopal wrapped in a white sheet and had multiple deep injuries across her body, including marks on her face, head, waist, and private parts. Preliminary post-mortem findings confirm belt marks and severe wounds, raising suspicion of brutal physical assault.

Her sister claimed the violence appeared to be the result of a conspiracy involving multiple people, not just one. The family further alleged that Qasim had been pressuring Khushboo to convert to Islam and marry him.

Police from Khajuri police station have detained Qasim Ahmed for interrogation. Officials said they are investigating all angles, including murder, rape, and religious coercion, and are awaiting the full post-mortem report.

Authorities are also examining CCTV footage, mobile data, and medical evidence to establish the chain of events. Meanwhile, Khushboo’s family has demanded a fair and transparent investigation and strict punishment for those responsible.

articles.title: Meerut Horror: Wife Drugs and Strangles Husband, Dumps Body in Canal with Lover’s Help
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut, Uttar Pradesh — A shocking case has surfaced from the Rohta police station area, where a woman, in collusion with her lover, brutally murdered her husband and tried to pass it off as an accident.

body.html:
Meerut, Uttar Pradesh — A shocking case has surfaced from the Rohta police station area, where a woman, in collusion with her lover, brutally murdered her husband and tried to pass it off as an accident.

According to Superintendent of Police (Rural) Abhijeet Kumar, the deceased has been identified as Anil. Initially, his death was reported as a drowning, but a detailed police probe revealed it was a planned murder.

Police grew suspicious of Anil’s wife, Kajal, during questioning. She later confessed that she had been married for eight years and had three children, but had rekindled her relationship with her former lover, Akash, two years ago. The two, along with Akash’s friend Badal, hatched a plan to eliminate Anil.

As per the plan, Kajal drugged her husband, strangled him with a scarf, and, with the help of her lover and his friend, threw the unconscious man into a canal, making it appear like an accidental drowning.

Police have arrested Kajal, Akash, and Badal, and booked them under sections of murder and criminal conspiracy. Further interrogation is underway to uncover all details of the case.

SP Abhijeet Kumar also noted that in the past eight months, four similar husband-murder cases linked to extramarital affairs have been reported in the district.
